theorems.name: Submission.deformation_ipl_mwc_mil_ae_fderiv_eq_proj
theorems.statement: ∀ (k Q : ℕ) (Ω : Set (Eucl k)) (C : ℝ≥0) (v : Eucl k → Eucl Q) (c : Fin Q) (g : Eucl k → ℝ), IsOpen Ω → LipschitzOnWith C v Ω → EqOn g (fun w => EuclideanSpace.proj c (v w)) Ω → ∀ᵐ w ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl k)), w ∈ Ω → ∀ x : Eucl k, fderiv ℝ g w x = EuclideanSpace.proj c (fderiv ℝ v w x)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
